title: Learning Unbiased News Article Representations: A Knowledge-Infused Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on predicting the political leaning (left, center, right) of news articles using a media-based data split (where test set news domains are completely unseen during training) to measure algorithmic political bias tied to news publishers, and assessing the debiasing effect of infusing external knowledge from Wikipedia and presidential debates.
